profile.legalName: Clemente Course In The Humanities Inc
profile.summary: The Clemente Course in the Humanities is a national nonprofit that offers free college-level humanities courses to adults facing economic hardship. Courses cover subjects such as philosophy, history, literature, art history and writing, and students can earn college credit. More than 30 courses operate across the United States and Canada, with Bard College as the main academic partner.
